method: ToS-safe: local plain caches/manifests, app-bundle JSON, saved drafts, official help pages. No network calls to CapCut, no traffic capture, no decompiling, no decryption.

paths.$CACHE: $DATA/Cache/ressdk_db/*/rp.db, table http_cache (local resource-panel cache; read from a /tmp copy)
paths.$PYJ: https://github.com/GuanYixuan/pyJianYingDraft @6bb2d06 (MIT open-source draft writer; JianYing-first, shapes not verified on CapCut 9.5)

legend.mcp_support: yes | partial | no | impossible (impossible_reason says why: needs CapCut-generated analysis/render/download files, or the value is not persisted in the draft)
legend.confidence: high = seen in a CapCut-saved 9.5.0 file or app bundle; medium = local evidence + open-source writer; low = docs only or unknown
legend.tier: free | pro | mixed (per resource is_vip) | unknown
legend.status: out_of_scope = AI/cloud or credit feature, not mapped (<owner> 2026-10-03); absent = in scope

summary.note: Counts exclude out_of_scope (AI/cloud, <owner> 2026-10-03). unknown = in-scope rows still 'no' (neither implemented nor proven impossible).

features.name: Speed curve
draft_fields: target_timerange.duration = source duration / average speed, snapped to the nearest frame
features.notes: Session 6 (23:18-23:24): all 6 presets, custom default, custom 1-1-4-1-1 (and 5.75 peak) and two mixed 1/2 custom curves on an 8 s clip at 30 fps. Rule: average = 1 / sum over segments of dx / mean(y_i, y_i+1); matches all 10 stored values to 1e-7 (float32). Target = source / average, nearest frame (8 s Montaje -> 5.5 s, Heroe -> 3.8667 s, 5 s Montaje -> 3.4333 s). The session-1 5 s save stored source/target (1.4563) instead of the exact average (1.4534). The editor draws a smooth curve, but the stored speed uses straight segments. Custom drags can insert an extra point at x + 0.000001; a clean all-2 curve was not captured (the rule gives 2 trivially). Curve tab shows a Pro diamond.
